$comment: The acceptance gate fails on any compact-health problem that is NOT listed here.
An entry means: this degradation is known, has an owner record, and must not page.
It does NOT mean the problem is acceptable forever -- expiresAt forces a re-review,
and the gate fails outright once that date passes.
A temporary rollout entry may add an entry-level `expiresAt` bounded to the first
scheduled cron window. At or after that instant, its live problem blocks even when
the root expiresAt is later. A health-probe cutover requires either a completed
Railway-side pre-seed or this owner-bound, expiring acknowledgement.
Entries are matched on name:status exactly. A source that recovers is reported as
'recovered' on the next run (prune it); a source that fails with a DIFFERENT status
than the one baselined is treated as new and blocks, which is the point.
Every entry carries a real tracking issue, never the PR that introduced the entry:
a merged PR closes, and a suppression pointing at a closed PR has no owner.
Softening fault statuses is the marketImplications blind spot the ON_DEMAND_KEYS policy
block in api/health.js exists to prevent.

acknowledged.name: mineralProduction
acknowledged.reason: USGS/BGS mineral-production probe has never published. Root cause found in #6799: seed-bundle-static-ref admits a section only when its DECLARED worst case fits the budget left on the tick, and Arms-Suppliers burned 390s of the 570s budget before failing gracefully, so this section was deferred on every tick and never ran. The concurrency fix (#6807) brings Arms-Suppliers to ~277s, which leaves room for this 190s reservation. Re-anchored to the first 03:00 UTC tick after that deploy; EMPTY after it is a real problem.

acknowledged.name: armsSuppliersBundleTick
acknowledged.reason: New 1-section arms-suppliers cron (#6806 PR1). The heartbeat key does not exist until the planned Railway service is provisioned and fires `0 4 * * *`. EMPTY before that first scheduled tick is the deploy window, not a frozen scheduler.

acknowledged.name: militaryBasesBundleTick
acknowledged.reason: New 1-section military-bases cron (#6806 PR1). Same add-then-remove cutover as arms-suppliers: EMPTY until the planned service's first `0 5 * * *` fire is expected. After expiry, silence is a real frozen scheduler.
